slides.headline: [FOLLOW] KE BAAD LINK
slides.label: SHORT ANSWER
lines: DM ka link **tabhi** jab woh **follow** karein. Isse **follow gate** bhi kehte hain.

slides.headline: TAP PE [CHECK]
slides.label: THE CHECK
lines: Instagram follow check tabhi allow karta hai jab woh DM mein **reply/tap** karein.

slides.headline: NAHI KIYA? [RETRY]
slides.label: IF NOT
lines: Followers ko link. Baaki ko **friendly** "follow first" + **try again** button.

slides.headline: [FOLLOWERS] KA JUMP
slides.label: RESULTS
lines: Keyword + follow gate: creators ko usually **followers mein bada jump**. Follows **per reel** count.

slides.headline: KAUNSA [PLAN]?
slides.label: FAQ
lines: **Starter** aur upar. **Beta** mein **har feature free**. Official API, rules ke andar.
